sources.title: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5: Key Management
sources.titleEn: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5: Key Management
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Linux Audit：事件組裝、遺失計數與可追溯性
related.titleEn: Linux Audit: event assembly, loss counters and traceability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：20與30秒僅為序列模型，所有用途隔離測試通過；教材不執行真實金鑰銷毀且不含私鑰。 交付金鑰用途/狀態矩陣、重包時間預算與可恢復性驗收單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Label 20 and 30 seconds as sequential-model values, pass purpose-isolation tests and include no real key destruction or private keys. Deliver purpose/state matrices, a rewrap time budget and recoverability acceptance record.
related.difference: 以合成SYSCALL、PATH與CWD紀錄依事件序號與來源主機組裝；分開定義record數、event數與實際操作數，保留lost/backlog狀態。
related.differenceEn: Assemble synthetic SYSCALL, PATH and CWD records by event serial and host; distinguish record, event and operation counts and retain lost/backlog state.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 包封重包成本近似金鑰數×每次重包時間；重包資料金鑰不等同重加密所有資料，停用與銷毀也有不同可恢復性後果。 教學10000個資料金鑰，每個序列重包2毫秒；忽略排隊、網路與平行化。 10000×2/1000=20秒；金鑰增至15000個後為30秒。
完整事件率=具所有所需紀錄的事件/預期事件；不能拿稽核行數直接當操作數，多筆紀錄不代表多次操作。 合成預期1000事件，960事件紀錄完整，40事件缺必要PATH或SYSCALL；每事件記錄數可不同。 960/1000×100=96%；修復30事件後990/1000×100=99%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Envelope rewrap cost is approximately key count×per-key rewrap time; rewrapping data keys differs from reencrypting all data, and deactivation differs from destruction. There are 10000 teaching data keys at 2 ms per sequential rewrap, ignoring queueing, network and parallelism. 10000×2/1000=20 seconds; 15000 keys require 30 seconds.

Complete-event rate equals events with all required records divided by expected events; log-line count is not operation count because events span records. Expect 1000 synthetic events: 960 complete and 40 missing required PATH or SYSCALL, with variable record counts per event. 960/1000×100=96%; repairing 30 gives 990/1000×100=99%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CycloneDX VEX：適用性聲明與證據到期
related.titleEn: CycloneDX VEX: applicability claims and evidence expiry
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：20與30秒僅為序列模型，所有用途隔離測試通過；教材不執行真實金鑰銷毀且不含私鑰。 交付金鑰用途/狀態矩陣、重包時間預算與可恢復性驗收單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Label 20 and 30 seconds as sequential-model values, pass purpose-isolation tests and include no real key destruction or private keys. Deliver purpose/state matrices, a rewrap time budget and recoverability acceptance record.
related.difference: 為每個不受影響聲明附產品版本、理由、證據與重驗條件；未知不可默認成不受影響。
related.differenceEn: Attach product version, justification, evidence and revalidation conditions to each not-affected claim; unknown never defaults to not affected.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 包封重包成本近似金鑰數×每次重包時間；重包資料金鑰不等同重加密所有資料，停用與銷毀也有不同可恢復性後果。 教學10000個資料金鑰，每個序列重包2毫秒；忽略排隊、網路與平行化。 10000×2/1000=20秒；金鑰增至15000個後為30秒。
待處理=受影響+調查中+過期聲明；完成狀態與證據新鮮度是不同維度。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 20份合成聲明：8份有證據而不受影響、5份受影響、4份已修復、3份調查中。 初始待處理5+3=8份，占40%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Envelope rewrap cost is approximately key count×per-key rewrap time; rewrapping data keys differs from reencrypting all data, and deactivation differs from destruction. There are 10000 teaching data keys at 2 ms per sequential rewrap, ignoring queueing, network and parallelism. 10000×2/1000=20 seconds; 15000 keys require 30 seconds.

Actionable items include affected, under-investigation and expired claims; disposition and freshness are separate dimensions. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twenty synthetic claims comprise eight evidenced not-affected, five affected, four fixed and three under investigation. Initially 5+3=8 claims require action, or 40%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
